HOPE.read_scope: §§2.1–2.5 / Eqs1–10; §3.1 setup only, result section excluded
observed_mechanism: Semantic embeddings h_v^Phi_m from an HGNN backbone; full-concatenation shared MLP S plus a dynamic MLP D_m per meta-path (Eqs1–3).
Cosine similarity to per-meta-path learnable prototype p_m drives threshold/top-K/top-C node selection and sigmoid gating (Eqs4–6).
Dynamic experts sum through gates; shared/dynamic representations concatenate and fuse through a projection (Eqs7–8).
Total objective is downstream task loss plus prototype-matrix orthogonality (Eqs9–10); the regularizer is on prototypes, not an observed all-full probability-pool utility.
HOPE.conditional_credit: Activated expert branches receive fused downstream task-risk gradients depending on peers. This is the printed joint objective; exact implementation and trainable parameter list are not code-qualified.
HOPE.source_counterfactual_baseline: No recipient factual-minus-source-probe objective is specified in the inspected method scope. This is a bounded scope finding, not a whole-literature absence claim.
HOPE.IMDB_competence: Inspected setup lists Freebase, ogbn-mag, DBLP classification and Yelp/DBLP link prediction; IMDB is not among that setup. SeHGNN is an evaluated backbone, but there is no matched IMDB TRAIN/VALID competence evidence here. Author scores are not adopted.
replication_limits: No author implementation audited; a paper-wide URL locator found no author repository link, only arXiv/LaTeXML support links. This does not prove that code is unavailable.

Eq9 prints ||P^T P−I||_F^2 equal to a sum of normalized off-diagonal squared cosines. These are generally unequal without unit-norm prototypes and matching diagonal treatment; which implementation was used is unresolved.
Method Top-K/Top-C notation describes node counts, whereas setup gives K=0.5 and C=3 without defining their scaling in the inspected scope. Resolve code semantics before a faithful reproduction.
Hard selection and prototype gradient handling, per-node batching dependence, embedding preparation and role/selection contract are not implementation-qualified.
HOPE.disposition: Useful recent semantic-expert competitor mapping, not an authorized new arm or matched result.

CoR.read_scope: §§3.1–3.3, Eqs1–9; floated result tables excluded from retained excerpt
observed_mechanism: Frozen-model calibration stratifies tokens by factual NLL into hard/easy subsets (§3.2.1).
Layer output perturbation produces hard/easy loss-sensitivity ratio R_l (Eqs3–4).

For expert e, CEI uses hard tokens on which e was originally selected; ablate e, renormalize remaining gate mass, score counterfactual NLL minus factual NLL, and average over expert-specific T_l,e (Eqs5–7).
At inference, redistribute per-layer activation counts using R_l (Eq8), then rank experts by contextual gate probability plus normalized CEI prior (Eq9).
CoR.recipient_dependent_baseline: Yes, a concrete expert-specific removal context and expert-specific calibration cohort change the evaluated counterfactual loss. This is a prior for counterfactual expert utility and routing allocation.
CoR.training_status: The inspected two-phase method computes calibration statistics and alters inference routing. It supplies no expert-body training update or recipient source-probe loss derivative. The abstract explicitly calls the framework training-free.
limits_for_pilot: Expert removal is a different intervention from retaining recipient m and deleting raw source family a; it does not equal the pilot J_m=S_m−A_m.
Different T_l,e cohorts make raw CEI cross-expert values conditional on different query populations, whereas pilot U/D should retain complete same-query member×family matrices.
Eq5 normalizes j≠e gate mass, but the inspected formula/text does not settle all top-k rerouting/selected-peer implementation semantics; author code not read.

Eq8 rounds per-layer allocations and a method footnote writes sum k_l approximately K_total. Equal total activation count is not demonstrated exact total wall/CPU/GPU cost, especially including offline calibration.
No graph/IMDB competence demonstrated by this method scope; no transfer of author factuality scores.

author_code_locator.read_status: URL locator only; repository and implementation not fetched/read

CoR.disposition: Concrete recent counterfactual-baseline precedent; not an expert-training equivalence or executable matched pilot control.
